items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I knew all the top writers, because I was on the Robbins Music staff... Jack Robbins called me one day and says, 'Come down, I want to talk to you about that song you brought in the other day.'

ctx.x: Jack Robbins. I say -- Jack told me, he say, "Come down Monday, I want to talk to you," after he heard the broadcast.
What was the song, by the way?
